name: Sweet Sucre
source:
Main character dreams of his cake shop, so he participates in a cooking contest. He needs to choose opponents and fight against them in sweet duels.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角梦想开一家蛋糕店，于是参加了烹饪比赛。他需要选择对手，与他们进行甜蜜对决。
